accounting.direct_owner_policy: predeclared exact owner cache with registered opcode execution; no model fitting or model search
accounting.fixed_oracle_policy: hindsight best of the frozen eight; pays only its own trial and common evidence, no search; conservative fixed hurdle

full_cost_gate.reason: the measured proxy cannot establish complete lifetime cost; independent acceptance and publication remain required

accounting.same_information_policy: lightweight and learned both pay all eight completed search trials and the same selector
accounting.search_cost_scope: complete actual trials, including their future/retention diagnostics; conservative experiment account, not deployment-required prefix selection cost
accounting.search_quality_penalty_policy: search trials contribute resource cost; only the deployed arm contributes future decision loss
accounting.unit: frozen arbitrary weighted proxy units; not money or measured lifetime cost

cost_observations.peak_rss_policy: sum of per-process observed HWM; not a measured simultaneous peak or memory-time integral
cost_observations.rss_sampling_boundary: host before report construction/serialization; worker before final response serialization; exit rusage and later tail are unmeasured

retention.scope: same written support/cut through clean refit and repartition; not longitudinal new-data forgetting
